Australia hit EV tipping point as BYD confirms petrol sales overtaken; consumer shift accelerating (#36, #50)

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in the 1-3 month window as RBA rate expectations firm, iron ore prices soften, and construction sector fragility weighs on sentiment. Small-cap miners and gold names may outperform. QAN.AX faces near-term operational overhang. Bull case narrative (#62) provides a floor but rate headwinds cap upside. Expect volatility around RBA communications and global bond supply events.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive: EV transition, defence spending, and AI-driven labour demand support structural growth themes. However, iron ore shakeout, housing construction decline, and consumer sentiment deterioration cap broad market gains. Diversified miners, healthcare, and defence offer relative strength. Construction and rate-sensitive sectors remain under pressure. Australia's stalling per-capita growth vs Canada (#64) may force policy response.
